source.titleEnglishInternal: Keep a Tired Group Going at a Dawn Lodge Breakfast
source.objectiveEnglishInternal: Encourage a sleepy, cranky group, commit to a clear plan, and keep spirits up while the bread finishes.
source.speakingEnglishInternal: You are the group's organizer, and the AI plays cook Mirta and your sleepy companions Noor, Felipe and Greta: encourage them, commit to tasks with the future (me encargaré, saldremos), and keep spirits up with ¡vamos! and dale while the bread finishes.
source.readerTitleSpanish: Desayuno al amanecer en El Chaltén

readerVerbExamples.target: Yo me encargo del termo y de la yerba.
readerVerbExamples.native: I take care of the thermos and the yerba.

readerVerbExamples.target: Salimos a las 6 con las viandas.
readerVerbExamples.native: We leave at 6 with the packed lunches.

readerVerbExamples.target: Llegamos al sendero antes del amanecer.
readerVerbExamples.native: We get to the trail before sunrise.

readerVerbExamples.target: Greta, te cebo un mate mientras esperamos el pan.
readerVerbExamples.native: Greta, I'll pour you a mate while we wait for the bread.
We wait for the bread calmly.

archivedDraft.scene: At a hiking lodge, bread is still baking and the group shares tasks while the cook confirms when breakfast will be ready.

sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ドゥルセ・デ・レチェ（ミルクの甘いペースト）

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: In Argentina, facturas are sweet breakfast pastries, not invoices.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ファクトゥーラス（アルゼンチンの菓子パン）

sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Common Argentine word for food you take with you.
Argentine word; elsewhere chaqueta or chamarra.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Yo me encargaré del termo y de la yerba.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: I'll take care of the thermos and the yerba.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Future encargaré makes it a firm commitment.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 私が魔法瓶とマテ茶の茶葉を担当します。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: I'll take care of the thermos and the yerba.

sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Come on, we'll still leave on time!
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: さあ、それでも時間どおりに出発できるよ！
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Come on, we'll still leave on time!

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Felipe, tranquilo, el pan estará listo en un ratito.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Felipe, relax, the bread will be ready in a little while.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: フェリペ、落ち着いて。パンはもう少しで焼き上がるよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Felipe, relax, the bread will be ready in a little while.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Mirta, ¿cuánto le falta al pan, más o menos?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Mirta, roughly how much longer does the bread need?
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ミルタ、パンはだいたいあとどのくらいで焼けますか。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Mirta, roughly how much longer does the bread need?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Noor, ¿vos podés armar las viandas mientras esperamos?
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Noor, can you put the packed lunches together while we wait?
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Informal Argentine voseo: vos podés instead of tú puedes.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: ヌール、待っている間に持参する昼食を詰めてもらえる？
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Noor, can you put the packed lunches together while we wait?

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Greta, yo te cebaré un mate mientras se hace el pan.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Greta, I'll make you a mate while the bread bakes.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Cebar is the verb for preparing and serving mate.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: グレタ、パンが焼けるのを待つ間にマテ茶を淹れてあげるよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Greta, I'll make you a mate while the bread bakes.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Llegaremos al sendero antes del amanecer, ya van a ver.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: We'll get to the trail before sunrise, you'll see.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: 日の出前にハイキング道に着くよ。きっとそうなる。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: We'll get to the trail before sunrise, you'll see.

sourceCards.sourceSpanish: Dale, che, que el día va a estar hermoso.
sourceCards.sourceEnglish: Come on, guys, the day is going to be beautiful.
sourceCards.sourceNoteInternal: Informal; dale and che are everyday Argentine encouragement.
sourceCards.targetJapaneseDraft: さあ、みんな、今日はきっとすばらしい一日になるよ。
sourceCards.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Come on, guys, the day is going to be beautiful.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: A las 5 de la mañana, Sam y sus compañeros Noor, Felipe y Greta desayunan en un albergue de El Chaltén antes de salir a caminar.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: At 5 in the morning, Sam and his companions Noor, Felipe and Greta are having breakfast at a lodge in El Chaltén before heading out to hike.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 朝5時、サムと仲間のヌール、フェリペ、グレタは、ハイキングに出る前にエル・チャルテンの山小屋で朝食をとっています。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: At 5 in the morning, Sam and his companions Noor, Felipe and Greta are having breakfast at a lodge in El Chaltén before heading out to hike.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Mirta, la cocinera, saca la pava del fuego y avisa que el pan casero necesita más tiempo en el horno.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Mirta, the cook, takes the kettle off the stove and lets them know that the homemade bread needs more time in the oven.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 料理人のミルタはコンロからやかんを下ろし、自家製パンはオーブンで焼くのにもう少し時間がかかると伝えます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Mirta, the cook, takes the kettle off the stove and lets them know that the homemade bread needs more time in the oven.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Mirta, ¿cuánto le falta al pan, más o menos?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: Mirta, roughly how much longer does the bread need?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「ミルタ、パンはだいたいあとどのくらいで焼けますか」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: Mirta, roughly how much longer does the bread need?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Mirta: Unos 20 minutos, pero mientras tanto pueden comer las facturas con dulce de leche.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Mirta: About 20 minutes, but in the meantime you can eat the pastries with dulce de leche.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ミルタ：「20分ほどです。その間、ドゥルセ・デ・レチェを添えたファクトゥーラスを食べられますよ」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Mirta: About 20 minutes, but in the meantime you can eat the pastries with dulce de leche.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Felipe está de mal humor porque quería salir ya y dice que van a perder el amanecer.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Felipe is in a bad mood because he wanted to leave right away, and he says they are going to miss the sunrise.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: フェリペはすぐ出発したかったので不機嫌になり、日の出を見逃すと言います。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Felipe is in a bad mood because he wanted to leave right away, and he says they are going to miss the sunrise.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Felipe, tranquilo, el pan estará listo en un ratito.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: Felipe, relax, the bread will be ready in a little while.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「フェリペ、落ち着いて。パンはもう少しで焼き上がるよ」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: Felipe, relax, the bread will be ready in a little while.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Llegaremos al sendero antes del amanecer, ya van a ver.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: We'll get to the trail before sunrise, you'll see.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「日の出前にハイキング道に着くよ。きっとそうなる」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: We'll get to the trail before sunrise, you'll see.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam explica el plan del día con calma: saldrán a las 6, caminarán 2 horas hasta la laguna y volverán al albergue a la tarde.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam calmly explains the plan for the day: they will leave at 6, hike 2 hours to the lagoon and come back to the lodge in the afternoon.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サムは今日の予定を落ち着いて説明します。6時に出発し、ラグーンまで2時間歩き、午後に山小屋へ戻ります。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam calmly explains the plan for the day: they will leave at 6, hike 2 hours to the lagoon and come back to the lodge in the afternoon.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Yo me encargaré del termo y de la yerba.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: I'll take care of the thermos and the yerba.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「私が魔法瓶とマテ茶の茶葉を担当します」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: I'll take care of the thermos and the yerba.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Noor, ¿vos podés armar las viandas mientras esperamos?
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: Noor, can you put the packed lunches together while we wait?
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「ヌール、待っている間に持参する昼食を詰めてもらえる？」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: Noor, can you put the packed lunches together while we wait?

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Noor bosteza, pero prepara cada vianda con queso y fruta, y deja lugar para el pan.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Noor yawns, but she fills each packed lunch with cheese and fruit and leaves room for the bread.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ヌールはあくびをしながら、それぞれの昼食にチーズと果物を詰め、パンを入れる場所を残します。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Noor yawns, but she fills each packed lunch with cheese and fruit and leaves room for the bread.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Greta tiene frío y no encuentra ni su campera ni su linterna frontal.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Greta is cold and can't find her jacket or her headlamp.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: グレタは寒がっていて、ジャケットもヘッドランプも見つけられません。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Greta is cold and can't find her jacket or her headlamp.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Felipe, ya más tranquilo, le dice: Greta, las dos cosas están en tu mochila.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Felipe, calmer now, tells her: Greta, both things are in your backpack.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 落ち着いたフェリペは、「グレタ、二つとも君のリュックに入っているよ」と伝えます。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Felipe, calmer now, tells her: Greta, both things are in your backpack.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Greta, yo te cebaré un mate mientras se hace el pan.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: Greta, I'll make you a mate while the bread bakes.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「グレタ、パンが焼けるのを待つ間にマテ茶を淹れてあげるよ」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: Greta, I'll make you a mate while the bread bakes.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Con el mate caliente y las facturas, el ánimo del grupo mejora mucho.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: With the hot mate and the pastries, the group's spirits improve a lot.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: 温かいマテ茶とファクトゥーラスで、みんなの気分はずいぶん明るくなります。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: With the hot mate and the pastries, the group's spirits improve a lot.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Mirta saca el pan casero del horno y le dice al grupo: Ya está, chicos, el inicio del sendero queda a 10 minutos caminando.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Mirta takes the homemade bread out of the oven and tells the group: It's ready, guys, the trailhead is a 10-minute walk away.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: ミルタは自家製パンをオーブンから出し、みんなに伝えます。「できたわよ。登山口までは歩いて10分です」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Mirta takes the homemade bread out of the oven and tells the group: It's ready, guys, the trailhead is a 10-minute walk away.

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: ¡Vamos, que saldremos a tiempo igual!
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: Come on, we'll still leave on time!
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「さあ、それでも時間どおりに出発できるよ！」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: Come on, we'll still leave on time!

sourceSettingReader.speaker: Narrator
sourceSettingReader.sourceSpanish: Sam: Dale, che, que el día va a estar hermoso.
sourceSettingReader.sourceEnglish: Sam: Come on, guys, the day is going to be beautiful.
sourceSettingReader.targetJapaneseDraft: サム：「さあ、みんな、今日はきっとすばらしい一日になるよ」。
sourceSettingReader.literalJapaneseGlossEn: Sam: Come on, guys, the day is going to be beautiful.

japaneseSpecificFocusCandidate: At a dawn lodge breakfast in El Chaltén, encourage the sleepy group, assign the thermos, yerba and packed lunches, ask cook Mirta about the bread, and state the departure and trail plan.
speakingGoalInternal: You are the group's organizer, and the AI plays cook Mirta and your sleepy companions Noor, Felipe and Greta: encourage them, commit to tasks with the future (me encargaré, saldremos), and keep spirits up with ¡vamos! and dale while the bread finishes.
speakingGoalJapaneseDraft: エル・チャルテンの山小屋で、眠いヌール、フェリペ、グレタを励まし、料理人ミルタにパンの残り時間を尋ね、魔法瓶とマテ茶の茶葉を担当すると伝え、昼食を詰める役割を頼み、6時出発と日の出前の到着を確認する。
sourceConflictInternal: The current 18-turn source is a 5 a.m. lodge breakfast in El Chaltén with Sam, Noor, Felipe, Greta and cook Mirta. It names the kettle, Argentine pastries with dulce de leche, mate, bread needing 20 more minutes, a 6 a.m. departure, a two-hour walk to the lagoon, packed lunches and a ten-minute walk to the trailhead. The archived 10-turn draft substitutes Misaki and generic weather/physical-condition checks; it is retained as evidence, not an answer or migration source. The source's timing relative to sunrise is unresolved and preserved, not independently verified.

savedPositionPolicy: Archived draft rows lack explicit stable IDs and were not learner-registered. Revision-scoped candidate IDs do not authorize saved-item or audio migration. Reordering requires a new revision.
reviewQuestionsInternal: アルゼンチンのファクトゥーラス、ドゥルセ・デ・レチェ、マテ茶、セバール（淹れて注ぐ）の日本語表記と説明は、現地文化と辞書の有資格レビューが必要。
源泉の『朝5時に朝食、パンはあと20分、6時に出発、日の出前に着く』という時刻を保ち、日の出の実際の時刻はこの教材から推定しない。
『ハイキング道』『登山口』『ラグーン』の地形・経路語を日本語の自然さと原文の区別の両面から確認する。
スペイン語の未来形とアルゼンチンの呼びかけ『dale』『che』は、語形の一対一置換ではなく日本語の励ましと約束として設計する。
旧草稿の14カード・10ターンは源泉の23カード・18ターンより短く、人物名、エル・チャルテン、マテ茶と具体的な役割を欠く。位置や音声の自動移行を認めない。
